text: For an ordinal $\alpha$, its successor $\alpha + 1$ is defined to be:
explanation: The successor is $\alpha+1 = \alpha \cup \{\alpha\}$, adjoining $\alpha$ itself as a new greatest element. $\{\alpha\}$ alone is not transitive; $\mathcal{P}(\alpha)$ is the power set (used to build $V_{\alpha+1}$, not the ordinal successor); and $\alpha \cup \alpha = \alpha$ changes nothing.
